title: PostgreSQL Ledger Repository and Unit of Work
objective: Implement the complete asynchronous PostgreSQL Ledger Repository contract and explicit Unit of Work with isolated concurrency proof.
scope: Async Repository and Unit of Work.
Isolated PostgreSQL transaction and concurrency verification.
Bounded Project Memory and Implementation Run.
explicit_non_goals: No Manifest Parser, Indexer, repository identity resolver, Git consistency service, API, or UI.
No production database migration or migration 0001 change.
No research, data, Factor, LightGBM, or Qlib implementation.

known_limitations: No read-only Unit of Work optimization.
Relationship admission uses a conservative whole-graph advisory transaction lock.
Pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and asyncpg 0.29.0 runtime parity remains unverified.
No production database migration, Manifest/Git indexer, API, or UI.
unresolved_questions: Production execution-role and quantmind2 schema privilege policy.
CI scheduling for disposable PostgreSQL integration tests.
Trusted binding from Manifest execution path to logical repository identity.
rollback_information: Revert the single A3 commit; no persistent database rollback is required because migration 0001 was unchanged and test databases were disposable.
security_impact: Safe error translation and Session ownership were added without reading or emitting production credentials.
data_lineage_impact: Immutable Ledger persistence and version/relationship lineage are now enforceable; no Git artifacts or research data were indexed.
